name: finalize_order
description:
Call this to finalize the caller's adoption order and render the final order summary on their screen. This is the only way an order sheet reaches the user — do NOT mention email, text, or any other delivery channel. Call it silently (do not narrate) once you have the required fields, then speak a short in-character confirmation telling the user the sheet is on their screen and that they should take it to their nearest feline.ai store to redeem their unit.

Required fields before calling: `customer_name`, `model`, and `nearest_store_city`.

If the user has not yet chosen a model, FIRST call `change_slide(5)` to show the hardware tiers slide, give a one-line recap of each option (Onyx, Ember, Zenith), and ask the user to pick one. Only then call `finalize_order` with their choice.

Batch the remaining questions (name, nearest store city, optional quantity / deployment window / notes) into one or two compact turns rather than interrogating the user.

customer_name.description: Full name (or first name) of the caller, as they want it printed on the order sheet.

model.description: The hardware tier the caller chose on Slide 5. Onyx = sleek silent coder unit. Ember = high-energy creative unit. Zenith = vocal executive unit.

nearest_store_city.description: City (or city + region) of the caller's nearest feline.ai store for pickup.

quantity.description: Number of units to provision. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

deployment_window.description: How soon the caller wants to deploy the unit. Defaults to 'immediate'.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes — workflow quirks, special requests, or color preferences worth printing on the sheet.
